projects.name: HPC data center facilities across two sites for hyperscaler tenants
projects.quote: We are currently developing 600 MW of HPC data center facilities across two sites for hyperscaler tenants, and we currently operate approximately 207 MW of power at one bitcoin mining data center in Texas.

projects.name: Barber Lake Facility
projects.quote: With the net proceeds of the 2031 Convertible Notes, we funded capped call transactions which are generally expected to reduce the potential dilution of the Company’s common stock that will initially underlie the 2031 Convertible Notes, and expect to use the remaining proceeds to finance a portion of the construction at the Barber Lake Facility, continue to develop our sites, and for general corporate purposes.

projects.name: Luminant Power Agreement
projects.quote: At our Odessa Facility, we sell excess electricity that is available under the Luminant Power Agreement, but not needed in our mining operations, back to the ERCOT market through Luminant.
